stories.title: Stroud, defense star as Texans beat Colts to keep playoff hopes alive
stories.summary: C.J. Stroud and a swarming defense helped Houston beat Indy on 'Thursday Night Football.'

stories.title: Luis Jr. ends fight to play at LSU after Wade instructed to stop playing star
stories.summary: RJ Luis Jr. has decided to "stand down" in his fight to pursue another year of eligibility at LSU, his attorney told ESPN on Thursday night.

stories.title: Houston muscles past Kansas to cap 3-day run, stamp claim to No. 1 ranking
stories.summary: Houston made a clear statement it belongs atop the rankings, capping its run through the Players Era 8 win a 92-83 win over No. 11 Kansas on Thursday night.

stories.title: Wemby debuts 'shunk,' part jump shot, part dunk done with reason
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama said his new-look "shunk" was done because of a blister former from actually dunking.

stories.title: Stroud stays in 'groove' with another 3-TD night in Texans' blowout of Colts
stories.summary: C.J. Stroud had his third straight game with at least three touchdown passes and led the Texans to their fourth win in six games Thursday night against the Colts.
